name: Sector 07 on the Moon
description: Entity GUI's facility (airlock terminal, CCTV, easel, handheld) stands at Entity Origin's Shackleton Base on the Moon. Fly around it with the floating-origin camera; the handheld's Walk hands the camera to the facility's player inside, with its world-space GUIs.

entities.$comment: the solar system: its sky (space) and its Sun are the world's
seen from outside, the facility needs a far plane past its 100 m; the handheld waits in the pocket
out on the Moon the facility doesn't fade into its room's darkness, and the sunlit ground lights its walls a little
the camera: sol's flight, or (walking: the handheld's Walk) the facility's player, each going on from where it was

entities.text: The handheld's Walk takes you into the facility
